feature: Edit Concerts PR4 · Add a show you went to
note: Boards: design/design_handoff_edit_concerts/screens/ add_sheet_m (phone) and add_dialog_d (sm, desktop) = add-sheet; add_search_m and addendum 3 04-edit-your-concerts/add-search-d = add-search; add_none_m = add-none. Hand-walked, not in the sheet: add-tapped-d (tapping a pill mutates), add-unmark-m, add_end_m (scroll inside the sheet to the records floor; the kit's scroll moves the page, not the sheet), add-loading-m (throttle), add-error-m and add-tap-failed-m (block /v1/history/past-shows, or fail the PUT), the empty-Concerts placement of the row (no board), Electric and Light themes. Requires CC_PAST_ARTIST_NAME, the display name of an artist with more than one past show in our records.
